tools.name: Read GitHub releases
tools.description: Reads the newest releases of a public GitHub repository.

tools.name: Search Jira
tools.description: Finds tickets in a Jira project by words, status, type, the day they were done, the day they were created or the day they were last updated. Each ticket comes with its type and assignee. A long list is cut at 50, and the agent says so.

tools.name: Read a Confluence page
tools.description: Reads one Confluence page that the team allows, as plain lines.

tools.name: Find expiring certificates
tools.description: Reads the certificate list on a Confluence page the team allows, and finds the certificates that expire within 60 days and the rows a person must check.

tools.name: Create a Jira ticket
tools.description: Proposes a ticket. It is created only after an Approver approves it.
